CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2698 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head fe4af2898f3374a6ea98609ad7c27c18ae4151f6. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch fe4af2898f3374a6ea98609ad7c27c18ae4151f6 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-ratio-anchor-r2, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-ratio-anchor-r2 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-ratio-anchor-r2; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from handoff/r10-ratio-anchor (tip fe4af2898f3374a6ea98609ad7c27c18ae4151f6, which already merges the bot's bc73e53b; the killed_by/*.json conflicts took the fixer's newer re-pin over the bot's, only the reason lines differed); do not restart from main. update_pr merged origin/main (eceef457a) into it and prepr refused:

Main moved those lines; re-pin each against the current text (mutation_table.py --pin-killed) or triage it, with a null control.
(2) MUTANTS: "FIXTURE VACUOUS: window cache (--stats --window-cache did not take commit-to-PR map and per-PR reads from the file)" on the merged corpus. Establish whether this is main's own red (run the same entry at origin/main) or the branch's; if main's, say so and name the check; if the branch's, fix it.
Merge origin/main, resolve, re-run prepr to a pass, and re-handoff: push handoff/r10-ratio-anchor (new 40-hex tip) and handoff-body/r10-ratio-anchor per the fixer contract. Report the new handoff SHA.
